description: List stored API-key accounts: account ID, wallet address, network and public key. No secrets are returned. Use an accountId from this list as the `account` argument on other tools. Call this first when the account is unknown.

ids.description: Output only account IDs, one per line (for scripting/piping)

network.description: Network override for this call. Defaults to ORDERLY_MCP_NETWORK, then the CLI config.

name: auth_list
title: List Orderly accounts
